caption: Somatic variant landscape of the 12 most frequently mutated genes across 60 samples. Each column is a sample (sorted by mutation pattern) and each row a gene; percentages give the fraction of samples mutated. Top, number of variants per sample. Multi hit, more than one variant in the gene.
